| • | Fish Audio Drama 3 ↗  —  AI voice acting you can direct, not just generate  Fish Audio Drama 3 lets you direct a line, not just generate one. You mark where the voice whispers, where it laughs, where it stops, and where the feeling turns over halfway through a sentence, which is the bit that usually makes a reading technically correct and still wrong. It handles several characters talking to each other, runs in 83 languages, and the weights are there to download. The thing they are building next is the one everybody doing dialogue actually wants, which is changing a single word without re-rolling the whole take and losing the performance you already had. |

Text-to-Speech Software

Fish Audio is the most expressive and emotionally rich text-to-speech model. It generates lifelike voices that capture emotion, rhythm, and nuance with remarkable realism. Fish Audio Voice Clone recreates a natural voice from just 10 seconds of audio—preserving accent, tone, and speaking habits.
